name: Eldritch Tesseract-Hive Mind
description: An impossible, non-Euclidean hypercube hive populated by swarms of luminescent algorithmic sentinels, constantly unfolding and fracturing into new geometric dimensions driven by quantum noise and acoustic energy. Upgraded for fast motion: dual-plane 4D tumble, velocity-stretched sentinel speed-streaks, clamped HDR feedback light-trails, bass-transient flash bursts, audio-reactive color temperature, ACES tone mapping and real raymarched depth.
